verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Your presence is all I am longing for
Here in the secret place
Your nearness is all I am waiting for
Here in the quiet place
Here in the secret place

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
My soul waits for You alone
Like the watchmen wait for dawn
Here I’ve finally found the place
Where we’ll meet, Lord, face to face

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
I’ve finally found where I belong
I’ve finally found where I belong, in Your presence
I’ve finally found where I belong
It's to be with You, to be with You

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
I am my Beloved’s and He is mine
So come into Your garden
And take delight in me, take delight in me

verse.name: b2
verse.lines:
Delight in me
Delight in me
Delight in me
Delight

verse.name: b3
verse.lines:
Here in Your presence, God
I find my rest
Here in Your presence, God

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
You're all I want
You're all I've ever needed
You're all I want
Help me know You are near
